messages:
Lena (People Ops): All-hands in ~25m. Green room meetup 14:20 in conference A and Zoom green-room link. Quick thread for captions, recording targets, and last-minute agenda swaps.
Carlos (AV): Bringing main rig + backup laptop. Testing live captions (Otter) and a local RTMP ingest via SRT as a fallback. If live captions glitch we'll switch to prepped VTT file.
Jun (Eng): Noted. For the demo stream, recommend enabling encoder tweak: keyint=48 and profile=baseline to reduce player buffering. Also set bitrate cap to 4.5Mbps for office wifi.
Priya (Product): Can we move the roadmap Qs to after the customer spotlight? Want the demo to land before the deep convo.
Sam (CEO): Fine with that. Keep Q block to 25 minutes so we have time for breakout follow-ups.
Rory (Legal): Small ask: any customer screenshots must have written permission before we publish the recording. If you plan to show SSO flows mask emails.
Lena (People Ops): Please mark the slide with "CUSTOMER CONTENT" if it needs legal review. We'll triage fast.
Carlos (AV): CaptionBot setup: Captions engine on, language English (US). If Otter latency > 6s we'll toggle local caption overlay using OBS.
CaptionBot: Captions enabled  latency ~2s.
Jun (Eng): If OBS CPU climbs > 70% switch encoder to hardware NVENC and reduce canvas from 1080->720. Also recommend recording to external SSD: /mnt/ssd1/all-hands-1791004321.mp4 to avoid dropped frames.
Carlos (AV): External SSD already attached. Also testing SRT ingest: srt://ingest.redwood:8888?streamid=allhands1791. If RTMP fails, we'll flip to SRT (lower packet loss).
Priya (Product): Quick slide change: move "Billing roadmap" to after "Scale improvements". New order will be: 5->6->4.
Lena (People Ops): Got it. If you're a presenter, pop into green room 10m before your slot for a quick audio/slide handoff.
Sam (CEO): Reminder to folks: ask leadership questions here in the thread or in the questions doc. I'll monitor both.
Lena (People Ops): Questions doc link: https://docs.google.com/.../all-hands-q2 (drop Q + owner tag).
Carlos (AV): One more: set OBS encoder "Max B-frames" to 0 for compatibility with some players. Also we have a pre-recorded 90s clip that should be cued at T+12.
DeployBot: Recording started 4FD  writing to gs://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1791004321/master.mp4
Jun (Eng): If you see audio sync drift during live playback try toggling audio buffering off in OBS, or restart the obs-audio plugin: `obs-cli plugin reload obs-audio`
Priya (Product): We'll keep the live Qs in this thread and product-specific follow-ups in the doc. Also leaving a note to collect top 3 roadmap concerns for the breakout sessions.
Rory (Legal): Also flag any slide that mentions pricing or SLAs  those need final approval before posting externally. Send to legal-review@redwood.ai.
Lena (People Ops): ASL interpreter: confirmed, on Zoom lane 2. Caption overlay will be used on YouTube.
Carlos (AV): If YouTube ingest fails we'll still stream to internal slack huddles and post the recording after. I'll post `:warning: youtube fallback active` if that happens.
Sam (CEO): Leadership ask: be concise. We need time for live Qs.
Jun (Eng): Quick troubleshooting snippet for anyone grabbing logs: `ffprobe -v error -show_entries stream=codec_name,bit_rate -of default=noprint_wrappers=1 /mnt/ssd1/all-hands-1791004321.mp4`
Lena (People Ops): Two-minute warnings will be given via calendar buzzer + this thread. Also please use wired headphones if available.
Priya (Product): Post-meeting action: product will collect follow-up owners and post a 1-pager within 48h.
CaptionBot: Live caption confidence metric: 0.87. Switching to local VTT fallback in 10s if confidence drops <0.6.
Carlos (AV): Backup plan summary: 1) local SSD recording, 2) SRT ingest, 3) internal-stream-only if public ingest fails.
Lena (People Ops): Final: follow-up notes and action items will be posted to #all-hands within 3 hours and in the doc. Good luck all! :sparkles:
